input.rationale: Section 8.2 binds Ono and its Affiliates through the opening sentence of p0491 read with clauses (i) and (ii) of p0492, and fails the fallback on scope, duration and carve-outs: the prohibition reads on any product whose active pharmaceutical ingredient falls within a redacted compound class (Binimetinib and Encorafenib being named only as exclusions), the in-term trigger is an undefined redacted period, the covenant extends past termination to an unspecified anniversary of the termination date, and nothing permits Ono's internal development or acquired products or programs. An open-ended post-term non-compete of undetermined scope is walk-away territory. Our edits remove Ono from the class-based prohibition itself, substitute a covenant reading only on a product (other than a Product) containing the named compounds Binimetinib or Encorafenib, limited to the term with a twelve-month outer cap and with internal-development and acquisition carve-outs, and conform Array's termination trigger to that narrowed covenant. Array's reciprocal class-wide restriction, the royalty-termination consequence and the Article XIV cross-reference to Section 8.2 are preserved.

proposal.summary: Remove Ono from the class-based prohibition and substitute a named-compound covenant on Ono limited to the term with a 12-month cap and internal-development and acquisition carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a class-wide, open-ended non-compete on Ono, so we have taken Ono out of the class-based prohibition in the opening sentence and substituted, in place of the post-termination extension, a covenant limited to a product containing the named compounds Binimetinib or Encorafenib, applying during the term only with a twelve (12) month outer cap and carve-outs for our internal development and acquired products or programs. Array's reciprocal restriction and its termination right are retained, with the trigger conformed to the narrowed covenant.

ops.oldText: neither Ono or its Affiliates, nor Array or its Controlled Affiliates, shall Commercialize
ops.newText: neither Array nor its Controlled Affiliates shall Commercialize

ops.oldText: In addition, in the event that Array terminates this Agreement for Ono's breach pursuant to Section 13.3 during the [ * ], or Ono exercises its right to terminate this Agreement "at will" pursuant to Section 13.2 during the Initial Royalty Term, then neither Ono nor its Affiliates shall Commercialize a Competing Product or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
ops.newText: During the term of this Agreement, and in no event beyond the twelve (12) month anniversary of the Effective Date, neither Ono nor its Affiliates shall Commercialize in the Ono Territory a product, other than a Product, that includes Binimetinib or Encorafenib as an active pharmaceutical ingredient. This Section 8.2 shall not restrict (i) Ono's or its Affiliates' internal research or Development activities or (ii) any product or program acquired by Ono or its Affiliates through any acquisition of or merger with a Third Party.

ops.oldText: If Ono Commercializes a Competing Product in the Ono Territory during [ * ], Array may immediately terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: If Ono Commercializes a product in breach of this Section 8.2, Array may immediately terminate this Agreement.
